rationale: The original short thesis remains completely intact 7 minutes after entry, with GMED trading in the bottom quartile of its intraday range and remaining rejected beneath both the declining 5-minute 9-EMA ($72.13) and session VWAP ($72.54). The most recent 1-minute candle pushed up to test the $72.12 level near the 9-EMA on elevated volume (20,073 shares) and immediately rejected back to $72.01, confirming active overhead supply. With 9.14x relative volume and fundamental pressure from a guidance cut, holding for a retest of the session low ($70.74) with invalidation at $72.60 remains the optimal risk-reward decision.
